changelog:
Anime **Signs & Songs** subtitle tracks are now recognised, so a dubbed anime keeps its on-screen
text translated instead of losing subtitles altogether.

## ✨ New

- **Signs & Songs tracks count as forced subtitles.** Anime releases rarely mark their
  "signs only" track as forced; they name it instead. A subtitle track whose title contains
  **Signs & Songs**, **Signs and Songs**, **Signs/Songs**, **Songs & Signs**, **S&S**, **S+S**
  or **SnS** is now treated exactly like a forced track. The track's language still comes from
  its language tag, so this works for a French or Spanish S&S track as well as an English one.
  - **Watching the dub:** with *Show forced subtitles when audio matches your language* on
    (the default), the plugin now picks the Signs & Songs track to translate Japanese signs and
    songs. Until now it saw two ordinary subtitle tracks and turned subtitles off.
  - **Watching in Japanese:** with *Prefer non-forced subtitles* on (the default), the plugin
    now picks the complete track even when the Signs & Songs track comes first in the file.
    Until now it could pick the S&S track and leave the dialog untranslated.
- **Complete tracks are not mistaken for S&S.** Some groups call their complete track
  *Dialogue + Signs & Songs* or *Full Subtitles (Signs & Songs)*. A title that also says
  **full**, **dialogue** or **complete** is still treated as a complete track.
- **Plugin image.** The release zip now ships the plugin's cover image, for servers that
  install the plugin by hand rather than from the catalogue.

## ⬆️ Upgrading

Straight upgrade from 1.3.0.0 — no configuration changes, and no new setting: both behaviours
come from the two subtitle options you already have, whose descriptions on the configuration
page now mention Signs & Songs. Server compatibility is unchanged (**Jellyfin 12.x**); 10.11
servers stay on 1.2.0.1.

A Signs & Songs track whose title is translated (e.g. *Panneaux et chansons*) is not detected
yet. If your releases use such names, open an issue with the exact track titles and they will
be added.

## 🔧 Under the hood

- Detection lives next to the existing forced-keyword check in `LanguageHelper`, so every place
  that already understood forced subtitles picks up Signs & Songs with no other code change.
- Keywords match whole words only: *Designs*, *Signed* or *SS&S* are not read as S&S.
- 26 new tests cover every name variant, the complete-track guard, the dub and Japanese-audio
  scenarios, and a non-English S&S track.
